IGUI_StealthOverhaul_Description: Client display settings. Accepting them applies the change in the current world.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_Advanced_tt: Show the bar and cone layout settings. Colors stay listed either way.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ShowIndicators_tt: Draw the awareness bar on zombies this client is showing.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_DisplayCap_tt: How many zombies can show a bar and cone at once. The closest, most aware ones are kept.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_DiscoverRange_tt: How far away, in tiles, zombies are considered for bars and cones.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_DiscoverMs_tt: How often that zombie search runs, in milliseconds.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_RayCount_tt: How many rays form each cone. More rays hug corners more tightly and cost more.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_BarWidth_tt: Width of the awareness bar, in pixels.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_BarHeight_tt: Height of the awareness bar, in pixels.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_AnchorOffsetY_tt: Vertical offset of the bar from the zombie, in pixels. Negative sits above the sprite.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_SuspiciousColor_tt: Bar color while the zombie is still building awareness.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_SuspiciousAlpha_tt: How solid the suspicious fill is. 0 is clear, 1 is solid. The color picker does not keep opacity.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_DetectedColor_tt: Bar color once the zombie is tracking you.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_DetectedAlpha_tt: How solid the detected fill is. 0 is clear, 1 is solid. The color picker does not keep opacity.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_BarBackColor_tt: Color of the unfilled part of the bar.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_BarBackAlpha_tt: How solid the unfilled part of the bar is. 0 is clear, 1 is solid. The color picker does not keep opacity.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ShowCones_tt: Draw the cone overlay for zombies this client is showing.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_InnerBand_tt: Fraction of each cone drawn in the brighter inner color.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ConeMaxAge_tt: How long a sampled cone is reused, in milliseconds, before it is cast again.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ConeRefresh_tt: How many cones are recast each update. Higher tracks motion sooner and costs more.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_LosSteps_tt: How finely each ray searches for the surface it hits. More steps stop closer to that surface.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_MoveDistance_tt: How far a zombie must move, in tiles, before its cone is cast again.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_LookDot_tt: How sensitive cone recasting is to the zombie turning. Higher recasts after a smaller turn.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_SampleDistance_tt: Distance, in tiles, used to measure where the cone's side edges are.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_HalfAngleIters_tt: How many steps are used to measure the cone's side edges.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ConeInnerAlpha_tt: How solid the inner cone is. 0 is clear, 1 is solid. The color picker does not keep opacity.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ConeOuter_tt: Dimmer fill out to the cone edge.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ConeOuterAlpha_tt: How solid the outer cone is. 0 is clear, 1 is solid. The color picker does not keep opacity.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ConeLine_tt: Color of the line along the cone edge.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_ConeLineAlpha_tt: How solid the cone outline is. 0 is clear, 1 is solid. The color picker does not keep opacity.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_DumpInterval_tt: How often pair debug lines are printed, in milliseconds. Only when launched with -debug.
IGUI_StealthOverhaul_DumpRange_tt: How far those debug lines reach, in tiles. Only when launched with -debug.
